description: A thermostat heats a room in steps until it reaches the target
code:
room = 18
target = 21
steps = 0
repeat:
    room = room + 1.5
    steps = steps + 1
until room >= target
[room, steps]

description: The body runs once although the condition already holds
code:
stock = 10
orders = 0
repeat: orders = orders + 1; stock = stock - 3
until stock < 20
[orders, stock]

description: Rolls are drawn from a sequence until one lands on six
code:
rolls = [2, 5, 1, 6, 3]
tries = []
repeat: tries.push(rolls.shift())
until tries.at(-1) == 6
[tries, rolls]

description: A function returns from inside the loop before the condition is tested
code:
def first_square_over(limit):
    n = 1
    repeat:
        if n * n > limit: return n
        n = n + 1
    until n > 100
    return null
[first_square_over(50), first_square_over(10000)]

description: A method charges a battery until a class-level rule reports it full
code:
class Battery(level):
    this.level = level
    def charge():
        repeat: this.level = this.level + 30
        until this.full
        return this.level
$Battery.full = $Battery.level >= 100
phone = Battery(20)
[phone.charge(), phone.full, phone.charge()]

description: A queue is drained into batches by a repeat-until loop inside a while loop
code:
queue = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2]
batches = []
while queue.length > 0:
    batch = []
    repeat: batch.push(queue.shift())
    until batch.length == 3 || queue.length == 0
    batches.push(batch)
batches

description: A quantified condition waits until every sensor has warmed up
code:
sensors = [12, 15, 9]
ticks = 0
repeat:
    sensors = sensors.map(t -> t + 4)
    ticks = ticks + 1
until all t in sensors: t >= 20
[sensors, ticks]

description: A conditional expression in the condition picks the stopping distance
code:
fast = false
distance = 0
repeat: distance = distance + 7
until fast ? distance >= 10 : distance >= 30
distance

description: A failed iteration rolls back every step the loop already took
code:
class Tank(volume):
    this.volume = volume
if $Tank.volume > 100:
    throw "OVERFLOW"
tank = Tank(70)
try:
    repeat: tank.volume = tank.volume + 20
    until tank.volume >= 150
catch error:
    failure = error
[failure, tank.volume]

description: A loop adds buses until a derived count covers the riders and never runs again
code:
class Bus(route):
    this.route = route
riders = 95
buses = Bus.filter(bus -> bus.route == "A").length
repeat: Bus("A")
until buses * 40 >= riders
riders = 200
[buses, Bus.length]

description: Reading .value in the condition tests the current value at every step
code:
level = 1
doubled = level * 2
repeat: level = level + 1
until doubled.value > 7
[level, doubled]

description: A blank line and a comment line may stand between the body and until
code:
word = "ab"
repeat:
    word = word + word

# keep doubling until the word is long enough
until word.length >= 16
word.length
